properties.note: The detector the fact named as owed ('a defect fact whose subject artifact has a later accepted change and no INVALIDATES from any ChangeEvent') is built as defect_overtaken_by_change. Its claim that the detector 'would have flagged this fact on the day the fix landed' is REFUTED, not confirmed: the misread fact's subject was the reporting document (art:dev-storyflow-feedback-2026-09-04), not the part that was wrong, and the fixer carried no detected_at — so as specified the mirror is silent on its own origin case. What reaches that case is the other leg, fix_without_recorded_cause, which asks every fix for the INVALIDATES the fixer never drew. Measurement and bound on fact:the-root-cause-detectors-measured-on-reflow2s-own-design-and-the-mirror-misses-its-own-origin.
